title: CNMD - DrinkingWaterPumpingStation schema
description: A drinking water pumping station belonging to a water distribution network, aligned with FIWARE Smart Data Models and INSPIRE.

addressLocality.description: The locality, which must correspond to the municipality

addressRegion.description: The NUTS 2 region in which the locality is located

district.description: The administrative district in which the locality is located

type.description: Property. NGSI entity type. It must be DrinkingWaterPumpingStation.

backflowPrevention.description: Property. System protecting the supply against backflow. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

backupPower.description: Property. Description of the station's backup power system, which may include properties such as available, type, capacity, autonomy. Model:'https://schema.org/StructuredValue'.

datasetResponsibleParty.description: Property. Party responsible for the dataset. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

disinfectionSystem.description: Property. Description of the station's water disinfection system, which may include properties such as available, type, targetResidualChlorine, maxDoseRate. Model:'https://schema.org/StructuredValue'.

documentation.description: Property. Documentation of the station. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'.

filteringSystem.description: Property. Description of the station's filtering system, which may include properties such as available, type, meshSize, location, selfCleaning. Model:'https://schema.org/StructuredValue'.

flowMetering.description: Property. Description of the flow metering system, which may include properties such as accuracy, locations. Model:'https://schema.org/StructuredValue'.

image.description: Property. Images of the station. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'.

inletPipes.description: Relationship. Inlet pipes of the station.

installationDate.description: Property. Installation date of the station. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'.

leakageDetection.description: Property. Leak detection system, which may include properties such as available, method, monitoringPoints, alertThreshold. Model:'https://schema.org/StructuredValue'.

license.description: Property. License associated with the data. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'.

anyOf.description: Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity
Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity

maintainer.description: Relationship. Party responsible for the maintenance of the station.

maxFlowRate.description: Property. Maximum pumping capacity per unit of time. Units:'MQH'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

maxHead.description: Property. Maximum manometric head the station can raise the fluid to. Units:'MTR'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

maxInletPressure.description: Property. Maximum pressure required at the pump inlet for correct operation. Units:'BAR'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

maxOutletPressure.description: Property. Maximum pressure required at the pump outlet for correct operation. Units:'BAR'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

maxOperatingLevel.description: Property. Maximum fluid level in the station's intake reservoir. Units:'MTR'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

maxPower.description: Property. Maximum power consumption of the station. Units:'KWT'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

minInletPressure.description: Property. Minimum pressure required at the pump inlet for correct operation. Units:'BAR'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

minOutletPressure.description: Property. Minimum pressure required at the pump outlet for correct operation. Units:'BAR'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

minOperatingLevel.description: Property. Minimum fluid level in the station's intake reservoir. Units:'MTR'. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

numberOfPumps.description: Property. Number of pumps in the station. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'.

anyOf.description: Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity
Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity

outletPipes.description: Relationship. Outlet pipes of the station.

pumpMaterial.description: Property. Type of pipe material. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

pumpTypes.description: Property. List of pump types used in the station. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

refNetwork.description: Relationship. Unique code identifying the network to which the component belongs.

refParametersObserved.description: Relationship. References to observed parameter measurements of the station.

status.description: Property. Operational status of the station. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

updateFrequency.description: Property. Frequency at which the data is updated. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.

variableSpeedDrives.description: Property. Pump control by VFD, which may include properties such as installed, type, quantity. Model:'https://schema.org/StructuredValue'.

version.description: Property. Version of the data model. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'.
